journal/today.reflection_prompt: What is one small thing you are grateful for today?

journal/insights.ai_summary: Your reflections this month carry a quiet upward trend — especially after morning light and honest conversations. Anxiety still surfaces, often around long meetings and short sleep. Mornings are your most reliably grounding window.

journal/entries.title: A quiet morning walk
journal/entries.preview: I noticed the way the light moved through the leaves today. There was a small bird I had never seen before — a tiny moment of wonder before the day got loud.
journal/entries.body:
I noticed the way the light moved through the leaves today. There was a small bird I had never seen before — a tiny moment of wonder before the day got loud.

I am trying to do this more often: notice the small things before the noise of doing arrives. The walks help. The journal helps. Even the quiet ten minutes after, where I do nothing in particular, helps.

journal/entries.title: A hard conversation, but honest
journal/entries.preview: Talked with my sister about how I have been feeling lately. It was uncomfortable to admit but afterwards I felt lighter. We do not talk enough about the small heavy things.
journal/entries.body:
Talked with my sister about how I have been feeling lately. It was uncomfortable to admit but afterwards I felt lighter.

We do not talk enough about the small heavy things. I forget how much honesty actually helps until I practice it.

journal/entries.title: Tired but okay
journal/entries.preview: A long day at work that ended in nothing dramatic. I am learning that "okay" is a perfectly acceptable mood. Not every entry needs an epiphany.
journal/entries.body: A long day at work that ended in nothing dramatic. I am learning that "okay" is a perfectly acceptable mood. Not every entry needs an epiphany.

journal/entries.title: Cold and a little lonely
journal/entries.preview: The apartment felt too quiet. I am noticing I do better when I plan one small social thing each week.
journal/entries.body: The apartment felt too quiet. I am noticing I do better when I plan one small social thing each week. Tomorrow I'll text Maya and ask if she wants to grab coffee.

journal/entries.title: Therapy session — something clicked
journal/entries.preview: We talked about the way I tend to apologize before stating what I actually want. Naming it out loud felt enormous.
journal/entries.body: We talked about the way I tend to apologize before stating what I actually want. Naming it out loud felt enormous. I have homework: practice asking for one thing this week, plainly, without the cushion.

journal/prompts.text: What is one small thing you are grateful for today?
Describe a moment today when you felt fully present.
Where did you witness kindness — yours or someone else’s?
What is something you are learning about yourself this season?
What can you let go of, gently, before sleep?
Who are you missing today, and what would you tell them?
Where in your body do you feel today’s mood?
What did you do today that surprised you?
Recall a small joy from this week. Describe it in detail.
What is one boundary you are proud of holding lately?
